verdict.rationale: Abacum is an FP&A platform where automated data flows and model updates are a fair axis, so the story applies. The evidence never describes versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The closest items are an edit-history audit trail on data models and base versions for scenario planning. Both are adjacent features, and neither offers automation version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
